description:
This DreamApply listing (ID 8503534) is part of the Study in Estonia application system, where international students apply directly to Estonian university programmes. Many Estonian programmes offer tuition-waiver places to top-ranked applicants, decided with the admission file rather than a separate scholarship form.

Programme Highlights

  • Single-portal applications to Estonian universities
  • Tuition-waiver places common for competitive applicants
  • Programme-specific deadlines inside the DreamApply system
  • English-taught degrees across IT, engineering and business fields

Who Should Apply

Bachelor's graduates targeting English-taught Estonian master's programmes; requirements vary by programme within the listing.

Funding and Costs

Estonian universities offer tuition-waiver places for strong applicants; scholarship conditions appear with each programme listing. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Open the DreamApply listing, confirm the programme and its closing date, and complete the application inside the portal. Key deadline information: Application windows per the listed programme — check the DreamApply course page for its closing date.
